mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS tasks, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE t.ai_score IS NOT NULL) AS scored_tasks, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(t.ai_score) FILTER (WHERE t.ai_score IS NOT NULL), 2), 0) AS avg_ai_score, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE t.risk_level = 3) AS high_risk, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE t.risk_level = 2) AS mid_risk, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE t.risk_level = 1) AS low_risk, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 3) AS reviewed FROM qa_task t WHERE t.is_deleted = FALSE AND t.create_time >= CURRENT_DATE - make_interval(days => #{days} - 1)

SELECT COUNT(1) AS alerts, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE a.severity = 3) AS severe, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE a.severity = 2) AS warning, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE a.status = 1) AS pending, COUNT(DISTINCT a.tenant_code) AS tenants FROM qa_alert a WHERE a.is_deleted = FALSE AND a.create_time >= CURRENT_DATE - make_interval(days => #{days} - 1)

SELECT to_char(a.create_time::date, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS stat_date, COUNT(1) AS alerts, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE a.severity = 3) AS severe FROM qa_alert a WHERE a.is_deleted = FALSE AND a.create_time >= CURRENT_DATE - make_interval(days => #{days} - 1) GROUP BY a.create_time::date ORDER BY a.create_time::date

SELECT a.rule_name AS rule_name, a.rule_type AS rule_type, COUNT(1) AS alerts, COUNT(1) FILTER (WHERE a.severity = 3) AS severe, MAX(a.create_time) AS last_hit_time FROM qa_alert a WHERE a.is_deleted = FALSE AND a.create_time >= CURRENT_DATE - make_interval(days => #{days} - 1) GROUP BY a.rule_name, a.rule_type ORDER BY alerts DESC, rule_name LIMIT #{limit}
